source.title: Configure Biome
source.description: Guide to biome.json layout and per-language overrides, config file lookup order, including or ignoring files with globs, and which JSON files allow comments.

source.title: First-party extensions
source.description: Short install guide for official VS Code, IntelliJ/JetBrains and Zed plugins, including setting Biome as VS Code's default formatter.

source.title: Format all files
source.description: Getting-started guide: install as a pinned dev dependency, generate biome.json with init, run format, lint and check, plus editor extensions and biome ci.

source.title: Integrate Biome with your VCS
source.description: Git-only setup guide: respect .gitignore, and lint or format only files changed against a branch or staged for commit.

source.title: Language support
source.description: Support matrix of languages formatted and linted (SCSS, YAML, Markdown pending); enabling experimental Vue/Svelte/Astro and CSS-in-JS; JSONC trailing commas; Vue/Svelte lint false positives.

source.title: Philosophy
source.description: Brief contributor ethos: public decision-making, specific error messages with fix hints, minimal options, jargon-free naming, inclusive language, terminal output readable without color.

source.title: Linter
source.description: Guide to enabling or disabling rules, groups and domains, severity and CI exit codes, safe vs unsafe fixes, ESLint migration, slow memory-hungry linting.

source.title: useSortedClasses (JavaScript)
source.description: Experimental lint rule sorting Tailwind utility classes as a prettier-plugin-tailwindcss alternative; covers clsx/cva/tw calls, why fix-on-save skips it, unsupported plugins and screen variants.

source.title: Continuous Integration
source.description: Recipe contrasting `biome ci` with `biome check`, plus GitHub Actions, reviewdog PR comments and GitLab code-quality pipeline examples, including extended-config dependencies.

source.title: Git Hooks
source.description: Recipes for formatting and linting staged files with Lefthook, Husky plus lint-staged, git-format-staged, pre-commit framework, or shell scripts, including re-staging fixes.

source.title: Configuration
source.description: Reference for every biome.json option: ignoring files and folders with globs, per-language formatting like quotes and indentation, rule severities, and per-path overrides.

source.title: VS Code extension
source.description: Setup and settings reference: format, fix and sort imports on save, multi-root workspaces, custom binary path, Cursor install, LSP trace troubleshooting, 2.x upgrade.
